finding: Authorization must be deny-by-default and checked on every object request
exposure: Former shared fallback identity and client-controlled project IDs
decision: Require platform email before body parsing and scope every project/file/record query to its workspace/project
test: Gen1 auth/origin static regression plus hosted multi-account direct-ID test
verification: Automated source test passes; hosted two-account boundary UNVERIFIED

finding: Uploads need allowlists, byte signatures, opaque names, limits and authorization
user_need: Safe plan intake without storage abuse
decision: Validate count/total/item size, extension, MIME and magic bytes after early auth; generate workspace/project/UUID storage key
verification: Pure tests pass; hosted R2 behavior UNVERIFIED

finding: Partial cross-service writes and retries must not create orphan or duplicate projects
user_need: One upload creates one dependable house
exposure: D1 and R2 do not share a transaction
decision: Workspace idempotency batch, batch-linked file rows, created-project marker, scoped compensation and stale recovery
test: migration/idempotency tests plus injected D1/R2 failure
verification: Static/pure tests pass; provider fault injection UNVERIFIED

finding: Cross-site and duplicate mutations need accurate, correlatable failure
decision: Same-origin guard, early auth, idempotency key, safe ApiError and incident ID
test: static security test and hosted duplicate/log drill
verification: Source test passes; hosted logs UNVERIFIED

finding: Construction viewers need real navigable geometry and recoverable cameras
decision: Three.js WebGL, perspective/orthographic cameras, OrbitControls, pan/orbit modes, resize/context recovery and explicit disposal
test: Assistify digital-twin test plus actual device/render/context test
verification: Build/static tests pass; actual WebGL run UNVERIFIED

finding: 4D controls must change object visibility, not decorate a timeline
decision: Object stage metadata, cumulative/current visibility helper, direct stages and playback
verification: Pure object tests pass; rendered playback UNVERIFIED

finding: Users distrust geometry without source and uncertainty
user_need: Know what is verified, inferred, assumed or unresolved
decision: Provenance records, evidence colors plus text, inspector and nonvisual register

finding: GIS context must not be presented as legal survey certainty
exposure: APN, boundary, frontage, adjacent IDs, terrain

finding: Project context must persist across connected workflows
user_need: Switch houses without losing the active build
exposure: Upload, left rail and three product surfaces
decision: One project ID owns plan, estimate, modules and Growify records; persist active ID
verification: Source tests pass; hosted refresh UNVERIFIED

finding: Dense viewer tools need labels, state, recovery and bounded placement

decision: Exactly 12 labeled controls, disabled/loading/error states, Escape/cancel, internal scroll and mobile dock
test: exact inventory plus required viewport/zoom/touch matrix
verification: Static tests pass; rendered matrix UNVERIFIED

finding: Spatial canvas can remain 2D but surrounding content must stay reachable
user_need: No offscreen tools or scroll traps
decision: 100dvh shell, overflow hidden, intentional rail/drawer scrolling and mobile bottom sheet
verification: CSS source test passes; rendered matrix UNVERIFIED

finding: Canvas data needs keyboard and semantic alternatives
user_need: Use verification and stages without sight or precise pointer
decision: Named controls, live status, focus-trapped drawers, stage keyboard controls and structured object/dimension registers
verification: Semantic/source review passes; assistive-tech run UNVERIFIED

finding: Every supplied sheet and controlling revision must be inventoried
Model dimensions must reconcile to controlling written plan values

decision: Matrix of source/model/difference/status; model only known controls and label unknowns
test: explicit dimension equality plus official parcel relation
verification: Six explicit checks pass; three critical relationships UNVERIFIED

finding: Refresh and interruption must not erase or corrupt work
user_need: Dependable return to project and stage
exposure: project D1 state and local viewer preference
decision: Persist project data server-side, bounded local viewer state, idempotent upload retry and accurate errors
test: corrupt preference pure test plus hosted offline/refresh/multi-tab drills
verification: Pure recovery tests pass; hosted drills UNVERIFIED

finding: Hidden failures prevent support and safe launch
user_need: Understand failure and let operators investigate
exposure: routes, D1, R2, WebGL and deployment
